title: AstroML VariableStarClassification

stats.done_summary:
Completed the Variable Star Classification research task. The report (report/report.md) documents comprehensive feature engineering and model evaluation for classifying variable vs non-variable sources using symbol series features. Key deliverables:

1. Analysis code: code/analyze_final.py and multiple iterations
2. Results: outputs/results_summary.csv
3. Report: report/report.md with methodology, results, and discussion
4. Figures: 6 PNG files in report/images/ including feature importance, confusion matrix, model comparison, class distribution, and feature distributions

Best model achieved ~0.56 test balanced accuracy (Ridge Classifier), below the 0.78 baseline target. Analysis revealed minimal discriminative differences between classes in symbol frequencies, suggesting more sophisticated sequence modeling approaches may be needed.
